title.narrative: Immediate response with temporary shelter and basic living conditions, prioritizing people in vulnerable conditions, affected by Hurricane Oscar in critical municipalities of Guantánamo, Cuba

description.narrative: The project complies with life-saving and time critical shelter criteria and non-food relief items (NRFI) for the immediate provision of temporary and semi-temporary emergency shelter for hurricane Oscar affected people in the 4 the worst-hit-municipalities of Guantánamo province. In these territories, over 14,300 houses were affected, almost half of them (7,150) reporting total or partial roof collapses. Furthermore, close to 8,200 houses were affected by floods, reporting partial or complete loses of essential domestic items. A rights-based approach will be used to promote an immediate and gender-sensitive response. Priority will be given to families with women and people in the most vulnerable situations. This includes women who are pregnant, have children and/or are caring for dependents. Also, women with limited socio-economic resources, women members of families living in situations of violence or victims of gender-based violence. People with disabilities, who are sick or in need of permanent care, as well as senior citizens will also be prioritized.
